profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Angular & Spring Boot | Scalable Web Applications
profile.summary: Motivated Computer Science graduate with several years of software engineering experience in the LTL trucking industry. Skilled in full stack web development using Spring Boot and Angular, with a strong focus on building scalable, reliable, & maintainable applications. Dedicated to continuous learning, professional growth, and fostering respectful collaboration in team environments.
